page_title: VER 2-2 JUV | Verona v Juventus 17/02/2024, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+7' That's all for today as the game is over.
90+6' Carlos Alcaraz (Juventus) unleashes a bullet of a shot towards goal from the free kick, but his attempt is denied by the goalkeeper.
90+5' Ondrej Duda (Verona) gives away a foul for a clumsy challenge. Referee Marco Di Bello saw the whole situation. That's a free kick to Juventus.
90+4' Juan David Cabal (Verona) jumps for a header from the corner kick, but fails to steer the ball into the goal as it flies high over the bar.
90+4' Tomas Suslov (Verona) prepares to take a corner kick.

90+3' Ondrej Duda (Verona) attempts to set up his teammate with a scoring opportunity by chipping in a fine pass from the edge of the box, but one of the defenders intercepts his effort. The ball goes out of play. Verona are awarded a corner kick.
90+2' Federico Chiesa (Juventus) takes a wonderful touch after collecting a pass inside the box. He steers his low drive towards the left post, but the keeper dives low to keep the ball out.
90' 6 min. of stoppage-time to be played.
87' Reda Belahyane (Verona) receives a pass then lets rip from long range low towards the middle of the goal, but Wojciech Szczesny watches it all the way and makes an easy save.
86' The referee signals a substitution. Thomas Henry (Verona) is brought on as a substitute for Daniel Silva.
85' Here is a change. Jackson Tchatchoua is going off and Marco Baroni gives the last tactical orders to Diego Coppola (Verona).
84' Danilo (Juventus) is asking for medical treatment after picking up an injury.
83' Manuel Locatelli does a good job setting up Federico Chiesa (Juventus) on the edge of the box, but his nice effort curls just over the bar.
82' The referee allows time for a substitution. Andrea Cambiaso will be replaced by Timothy Weah (Juventus).
81' Massimiliano Allegri prepares a substitution. Dusan Vlahovic is replaced by Arkadiusz Milik (Juventus).
80' Ondrej Duda (Verona) whips in the resulting free kick but one of the defenders heads the ball to safety.
80' Manuel Locatelli (Juventus) commits an ugly tackle on his opponent, but there is no caution from the referee. Verona are awarded a free kick. Let's see what they create from this.
76' Dangerous play by Tomas Suslov (Verona). Marco Di Bello blows his whistle for a foul.
74' Michael Folorunsho is not able to continue due to his injury and will be replaced by Reda Belahyane (Verona).
74' Darko Lazovic will be replaced by Ruben Vinagre (Verona).
73' Michael Folorunsho (Verona) wants to continue but the body doesn’t look willing!
71' Daniel Silva (Verona) swings a cross into the box, but it's far too close to Wojciech Szczesny, who smothers the ball.
70' Tomas Suslov (Verona) is able to continue to play.
69' Tomas Suslov (Verona) picks up an injury.
69' Dusan Vlahovic (Juventus) receives a lofted pass in the goal area and unleashes a dangerous header which sails a few inches over the bar!
68' Federico Chiesa (Juventus) takes the corner kick and sends the ball among a huddle of players inside the penalty area, but one of the defenders clears it to safety.
66' Massimiliano Allegri has decided to substitute Kenan Yildiz and he is replaced by Carlos Alcaraz (Juventus).
66' Verona can’t profit from the corner as the defence clear the ball upfield.
65' Substitution. Tijjani Noslin makes his way off the pitch and Karol Swiderski (Verona) comes on as his replacement.

65' Darko Lazovic (Verona) produces a ferocious strike from the edge of the box. His dangerous effort towards the right post is blocked by Wojciech Szczesny, who pulls off a superb save to keep the ball out of the net. The ball goes out of play. Verona are awarded a corner kick.
63' Kenan Yildiz (Juventus) latches on to an accurate pass inside the box and shoots towards goal, but it goes well wide of the right post.
61' Marco Di Bello has a clear sight and sees a foul from Alex Sandro (Juventus).
58' Andrea Cambiaso (Juventus) collects a sweet pass on the edge of the box and in one movement smashes a shot in on goal, but it balloons high over the bar.
57' Massimiliano Allegri decides to make a substitution. Federico Gatti will be replaced by Alex Sandro (Juventus).
57' A substitution has been made. Filip Kostic goes off and Federico Chiesa (Juventus) comes on.
55' 2 - 2 Goal - 2:2! Manuel Locatelli tees up Adrien Rabiot (Juventus) inside the box and he rolls the ball into the bottom right corner and past Lorenzo Montipo.

52' 2 - 1 Goal! Michael Folorunsho displays great vision and sends a pass to Tijjani Noslin (Verona), who shows brilliant composure inside the box to bury the ball into the bottom right corner. The score is 2:1.
51' Tijjani Noslin (Verona) has an effort from distance and sends the ball towards the right post, but the goalkeeper is equal to it.
50' Daniele Rugani (Juventus) jumps into a tackle and Marco Di Bello signals a foul.
47' Ondrej Duda sends a lovely ball from the corner into the path of Giangiacomo Magnani (Verona), whose close-range header flashes just over the bar.
46' Ondrej Duda (Verona) steps up to send the ball in.

46' Juan David Cabal (Verona) produces a lovely ball into the penalty area but the defender manages to intercept and comfortably averts the danger. The referee blows his whistle, Verona are awarded a corner kick.
46' The game restarts for the second half.
45+4' The end of the first half.
45+3' Filip Kostic (Juventus) takes the corner, but the opposition's defence is ready and clears the ball to safety.

45+3' Dusan Vlahovic (Juventus) wastes a good opportunity as his pass into the box is blocked by the defence. Juventus have been awarded a corner kick. The referee and one of his assistants both point at the corner flag.
45' The fourth official shows 3 min. of added time.
43' Tomas Suslov (Verona) receives a good pass just outside the box, unleashes a strike from a promising position, but the shot is blocked by the defender.
40' Tomas Suslov (Verona) picks up a sweet pass and fires one in from distance low towards the middle of the goal, but Wojciech Szczesny is alert and makes a decent save.
39' Ondrej Duda (Verona) attempts to score with a first-time shot from the edge of the box. His effort towards the bottom right corner is saved by Wojciech Szczesny.
38' Darko Lazovic (Verona) finds himself in a promising position after receiving a precise pass. He pulls the trigger but only hits one of the opposition, who gets in the way of his effort.
37' Looks like Michael Folorunsho (Verona) is struggling after picking up a knock. Hopefully he can run it off.
33' The free kick from long distance is taken by Tomas Suslov (Verona), who fires in a direct effort just wide of the right post. What a chance!
32' Adrien Rabiot (Juventus) robs an opponent of the ball and explodes in anger when Marco Di Bello blows for a foul. A free kick to Verona.
32' 3:8 – the total goal attempt statistics.
31' Filip Kostic (Juventus) slaloms his way past challenges, but an opposing player does well to get the ball away.
28' 1 - 1 Goal! Dusan Vlahovic (Juventus) wins the battle of wills and sends an unstoppable penalty past Lorenzo Montipo into right side of the goal.
28' Dusan Vlahovic (Juventus) is heading towards the penalty spot to take it.
27' Jackson Tchatchoua (Verona) clearly handles the ball, but he is surprised when the referee blows his whistle. It's a penalty! Juventus have an opportunity to score from the penalty spot.
26' The free kick from Filip Kostic (Juventus) is cleared away from danger by one of the defenders.
25' Marco Di Bello blows his whistle for a foul after Ondrej Duda (Verona) hacks down one of his opponents. Free kick. Juventus will probably just try to cross the ball in from here.
25' Weston McKennie (Juventus) fires a shot well wide of the left post from inside the box after latching onto a short pass.
22' Tomas Suslov (Verona) will deliver the corner kick.
21' Juan David Cabal (Verona) whips the ball in, but it fails to reach any of his teammates as the opposition's defence averts the threat. Verona force their opponents to concede a corner.
19' The injury to Adrien Rabiot (Juventus) looks like it might have ended his involvement in this match.
18' That was close by Andrea Cambiaso (Juventus)! He receives a pass on the edge of the box and shoots, but the ball goes inches wide of the right post.
17' The resulting corner from Filip Kostic (Juventus) is cleared by the defence.
16' Weston McKennie (Juventus) goes on a solo run, but he fails to create a chance as an opposition player blocks him. The ball is out of play. A goal-scoring opportunity from a corner for Juventus.
15' Andrea Cambiaso (Juventus) sends a cross into the box, but Lorenzo Montipo comes off his line to gather the ball.
15' Kenan Yildiz (Juventus) takes a short corner kick.

14' That's unlucky! Adrien Rabiot (Juventus) beautifully controls a pass and from the edge of the box drills a shot in on goal, but it's inadvertently blocked by a defender and cleared. Juventus get a corner.
14' Tijjani Noslin (Verona) decided to shoot after receiving a sweet pass. If it wasn't for Wojciech Szczesny's superb save the ball would have probably ended up in the bottom right corner.

11' 1 - 0 Michael Folorunsho (Verona) gets to the ball on the edge of the box and fires in a first-time shot without any hesitation. The strike is excellent and goes inside the left post. He couldn't have done it any better. 1:0.
10' Tomas Suslov (Verona) goes over to take the corner kick and it looks like he will swing the ball into the penalty box.
10' Darko Lazovic (Verona) looks to break free, but an opposing player clears the ball away. Verona earn a corner.

8' Darko Lazovic (Verona) gets on the end of a pass on the edge of the penalty area and shoots towards the middle of the goal. He didn't put enough power into the effort, though, and Wojciech Szczesny pulls off an easy save.
7' Marco Di Bello couldn't ignore the rough tackle by Manuel Locatelli (Juventus) and blew his whistle.
6' Kenan Yildiz (Juventus) gets on the end of a pass on the edge of the box but his shot is blocked.
4' Michael Folorunsho (Verona) sends a teasing cross into the area, but Wojciech Szczesny intercepts the ball.
1' Juan David Cabal (Verona) makes a bad challenge and the referee blows his whistle for a foul.
1' Here we go, today's match is starting right now.
Juventus will kick the game off.
Marco Di Bello got the nomination for today's game and will try his best to be a fair judge and not make any mistakes.
Show lineups The starting XIs were already announced and you can go through them in the Lineups section.
